measurements.name: West Spitsbergen Current
measurements.range_interpretation: Threshold cases describe boundary-choice sensitivity, not confidence limits, temporal variation or annual extrema. Tube definitions cannot be averaged or added.
measurements.geographic_scope: Section A northwest/north of Svalbard, August 2015; local WSC stream-tube support. C is upstream of branch partitioning; tube 2 constrains a Svalbard-branch interpretation.
measurements.section_orientation: Source cross-current survey section; no geographic edge pair or flow-normal projection extracted.
measurements.layer: Property-defined Atlantic Water (practical salinity >34.88; corresponding rounded absolute salinity >35.05 g/kg; conservative temperature >=2 C), limited by seabed; not a fixed depth interval.
measurements.time_convention: Synoptic August 2015 cruise context, 12-21 August; exact section dates unextracted. Three sections span about five days, not seasonal phases.
measurements.boundary_rule: Tube 1: first transport-density drop on either side of core below AW thickness times 0.04 m/s; C offshore edge x=-11 km from SADCP. Separate 0.02/0.08 m/s sensitivity cases.
measurements.source_citation: Kolas, E. and Fer, I. (2018), Hydrography, transport and mixing of the West Spitsbergen Current: the Svalbard Branch in summer 2015, Ocean Science 14, 1603-1618, doi:10.5194/os-14-1603-2018.
measurements.source_locator: Table 2, printed p.1611, Width (km), section A, stream tube 1; methods sections 3.2-3.3, pp.1606-1608.
measurements.extraction_method: Transcribed original PDF Table 2 cells after rendering and visual inspection; numeric methods read. No new inversion or geographic edge digitization.
measurements.source_current_label: West Spitsbergen Current; locally constrained stream tube
measurements.source_quality_note: Original Table 2 and methods inspected. Brackets are threshold sensitivity; exact occupation dates and geographic width edges are unextracted. A1/A2 share one source tube.
remaining_gates: Independent scientific admission and identity review.
Recover exact section dates and geographic edge coordinates before mapped width or state intersection.
Obtain compatible repeated observations before seasonal or annual dimensions.
